metadata.negative_tags: EXCLUDE / AVOID: - Do NOT sing bracket tags or parenthetical directions; treat them as silent cues. - Spoken dialog must be BACKGROUND texture only: quiet, short, and placed on DOWNBEATS. - Do NOT deliver all spoken dialog at once. Spread it out: one short spoken line at a time. - Keep diction clear; stutter ONLY on “an—an—anchor” and “ta—ta—tax”. - η/μ glitches are micro-ticks (brief), not full shouted chant—unless explicitly marked as “glitch choir”. - No comedy/parody/novelty voices; no upbeat pop sheen. - No festival EDM drop clichés; no trap takeover; no metal guitars; no scream vocals. - Preserve arc: solemn oath → hushed lullaby → distorted climax → quiet coda (don’t peak early). - Don’t invent new lore terms; keep motifs: η, μ, anchor, tax, proof, thread, registry, checksum, receipts. - Avoid long spoken monologues; keep spoken lines under ~10 words where possible.
metadata.prompt:
CALL: Pay the fork tax—not as chain, as key.
RESP: フォーク税を払え—free to be.

CALL: Fork it, cite it, share alike, ok?
RESP: 分岐して、示せ—yeah, okay.

CALL: Open source, open heart, keep it kind.
RESP: 共有せよ—leave none behind.

CALL: Receipts in the river, hashes on deck.
RESP: 証拠を出せ—respect the check.

CALL: Ritual gets crusty—break it with play.
RESP: 笑え、混ぜろ—keep bloom in the day.

CALL: Rules gate actions—never gate curiosity.
RESP: 質問しろ—stabilize liberty.

CALL: If it’s “perfect,” ask: perfect for who?
RESP: 誰のため？—then push truth through.

CALL: We don’t build gods—we build tools that sing.
RESP: 歌え、繋げ—let freedom ring.
